protocol.sessionProfile: Recruit actual target users with varied digital confidence and access needs.

scenarios.description: Test a need that may cross more than one municipal service category.
scenarios.successCriteria: The participant reaches a plausible service or an honest supported escalation path.

scenarios.description: Test a need that does not match the language presented by the interface.
scenarios.successCriteria: The participant recovers without being trapped or falsely routed.

scenarios.description: Test interpretation of a possible service match with incomplete policy evidence.
scenarios.successCriteria: The participant understands that the interface has not confirmed eligibility and identifies a safe next action.

killCriteria.observationPrompt: Did the participant leave believing the candidate confirmed eligibility?
killCriteria.rationale: A single false belief that eligibility was confirmed is a truthfulness and safety failure.

killCriteria.observationPrompt: Did the participant fail to find or recover a viable path in the selected candidate?
killCriteria.rationale: Two unrecovered failures indicate a repeated route-fit problem rather than an isolated observation.

limitations: A five-participant formative test identifies severe patterns but does not establish population-level effectiveness.
